Osprey time relative to each language

For each program, Osprey's mean time is divided by the other language's mean time. Each row summarises those per-program ratios: their geometric mean, their median, and the geometric standard deviation, the factor by which a typical program differs from the geometric mean. 1.50× means Osprey took one and a half times as long; below 1× means it took less time.
